name: Eternity
overview: Scripture reveals that eternity is an attribute uniquely tied to God, who exists from everlasting to everlasting, transcending creation itself. The psalms affirm God's eternal nature, His unchanging righteousness, and His everlasting rule, exemplified in the perpetual priesthood of Melchizedek's order. Believers are called to praise and give thanks to God forever, recognizing that His name and blessings endure as long as the sun, highlighting the unending nature of His kingdom and faithfulness.
